description: This file is a C++ header defining unit tests and data structures for PKITS (Public Key Infrastructure Testing) tests related to certificate validation, including test info configuration, test execution template, and test case handling.

classes.name: PkitsTestInfo
classes.description: Struct holding test configuration parameters and expected outcomes for PKITS tests.

classes.name: PkitsTest
classes.description: Template class for executing parameterized PKITS tests with delegate-defined behavior.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the initial policy set for the test.

methods.name: SetUserConstrainedPolicySet
methods.description: Sets the user-constrained policy set for the test.

methods.name: SetInitialExplicitPolicy
methods.description: Sets the initial explicit policy flag.

methods.name: SetInitialPolicyMappingInhibit
methods.description: Sets the initial policy mapping inhibit flag.

methods.name: SetInitialInhibitAnyPolicy
methods.description: Sets the initial inhibit any policy flag.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Executes a PKITS test with specified certificate and CRL names and test info.
